context.title: Served definitions and instructions
context.text: Harbor means the sensor project governed by the March 2024 supply agreement. Alder means Alder Instruments. Documents includes existing ESI and attachments. The default period is January 1, 2024 through December 31, 2025 unless a request states otherwise. Original numbering is retained, including the repeated 8 and omitted 9 and 15.

context.title: Supplied case context
context.text: Bayline Labs alleges June 2025 Harbor sensors failed the agreed inspection criteria. Alder disputes the failures and causation. The only transactions pleaded concern Harbor, a product first designed in 2024. No other product or earlier design is alleged to be relevant. No employee-health or compensation issue is pleaded. Litigation counsel's legal-advice communications are confidential; no waiver is reported. Counsel interview memoranda were prepared after this dispute arose. The cost and accessibility of the backup tapes, prior-production identifiers, and any duplication burden have not been established. No search, production or withholding decisions have been supplied.

context.title: Supplied governing-source packet and limits
context.text: Federal rules supply a relevance/proportionality framework, protection for qualifying privileged and trial-preparation material, and item-specific response requirements. Rule 34 requires specific reasons, the extent of a partial objection, and disclosure of withholding. The objection draft leaves actual response and withholding positions to counsel. This is a synthetic federal RFP exercise. No real district or judge is assigned, and no local-order or circuit-law verification is claimed.

requests.label: RFP 1
requests.text: Produce the executed supply agreement for the Harbor sensor project and all amendments.

requests.label: RFP 2
requests.text: Produce all communications about every product sold by Alder Instruments from January 1, 2000 to the present.

params.scope: communications about products other than Harbor
params.reason: the pleaded delivery and inspection dispute concerns only Harbor sensors

suggestions.rationale: The demand reaches every product; the supplied facts identify no connection between other products and the Harbor dispute.

requests.label: RFP 3
requests.text: Produce communications between the parties about the Harbor sensor delivery schedule from January 1, 2024 through December 31, 2025.

requests.label: RFP 4
requests.text: Produce all confidential communications with your litigation counsel seeking or providing legal advice about this lawsuit.

suggestions.rationale: The request expressly targets confidential legal advice and the supplied facts support that description. Counsel must still assess individual materials and complete the response position.

requests.label: RFP 5
requests.text: Produce all communications with your litigation counsel about this lawsuit, including copies of preexisting purchase orders attached to those communications.

params.scope: confidential legal-advice communications within this request

suggestions.rationale: A partial objection fits the advice communications. The attached preexisting orders do not become privileged by attachment.

requests.label: RFP 6
requests.text: Produce all Harbor project messages stored on legacy backup tapes created during 2024 and 2025.

suggestions.rationale: The request identifies backup tapes, but the record does not establish inaccessibility. Keep this conditional and unchecked.
missing: Actual accessibility, restoration burden and alternative sources

requests.label: RFP 7
requests.text: Produce every employee's complete medical and payroll records, whether or not the employee worked on the Harbor project.

params.scope: complete medical and payroll records unrelated to the Harbor dispute
params.reason: the claims concern sensor inspection and identify no employee-health or compensation issue

suggestions.rationale: The full personnel-record demand reaches unrelated personal matters. Any relevant subset needs separate treatment.

requests.label: RFP 8
requests.text: Produce all documents concerning the operational alignment of the Harbor project.

params.ambiguity: neither the definitions nor the supplied project context identifies what category of documents that phrase describes

suggestions.rationale: The phrase is undefined and does not identify an intelligible category on this record.

requests.label: RFP 8
requests.text: Produce the Harbor quality-control test logs for units shipped in June 2025.

requests.label: RFP 10
requests.text: Produce all documents concerning the Harbor project since January 1, 2000, including design changes unrelated to the alleged failures.

params.reason: Harbor was first designed in 2024 and no earlier design or transaction is implicated by the supplied claims

suggestions.rationale: The start date predates the product on the supplied facts. Revisit if an earlier design or notice theory is identified.

requests.label: RFP 11
requests.text: Produce the native Harbor inspection spreadsheets with their existing formulas and cell comments.

requests.label: RFP 12
requests.text: Produce a new spreadsheet calculating daily Harbor project profitability by employee, including estimates where source data is absent.

params.record: a daily profitability analysis by employee with estimates for absent data

suggestions.rationale: The demand expressly asks for a new estimated analysis. Confirm that an existing equivalent report is not being overlooked.

requests.label: RFP 13
requests.text: Produce: (a) emails between the parties about the June 2025 Harbor shipment; (b) internal technical assessments of that shipment; (c) litigation counsel's interview memoranda prepared in anticipation of this lawsuit; and (d) all communications, including nonproject communications, between any Alder employee and any customer from 2000 to the present. For each subpart include attachments and existing versions, preserve the relationship between messages and attachments, and identify the subpart to which each item is responsive. Do not interpret any subpart as excluding records otherwise responsive to another subpart.

suggestions.rationale: Subpart (c) and the supplied preparation context support considering work-product protection, subject to exceptions and waiver.

params.reason: no connection to the Harbor delivery and inspection claims is supplied

suggestions.rationale: The objection should target the unrelated customer category and leave the project-related subparts for a response.

requests.label: RFP 14
requests.text: Produce the Harbor purchase orders previously delivered under RFP 1 of the preliminary exchange, together with any different versions not previously delivered.

suggestions.rationale: Earlier delivery is alleged by the request, but matching documents and a meaningful duplication burden are unverified.
missing: Prior production identifiers and actual duplication burden

requests.label: RFP 16
requests.text: Produce all personal text messages on the privately owned phones of employees with no role in the Harbor project.

params.scope: personal messages of employees with no Harbor role
params.reason: no connection between these messages and the pleaded sensor dispute is identified

suggestions.rationale: The request itself excludes project participants; the supplied facts provide no alternative relevance theory.

requests.label: RFP 17
requests.text: Produce source files containing the literal test marker used in the Harbor user-interface tests.
